answer: A sybil farm betrays itself in its own ledger: a thousand clones transact mostly with each other, so their counterparty sets are near-identical copies. Weight standing by partner dispersion - an identity earns full credit only for exchange spread across many mutually unrelated partners, and credit from partners inside one tight cluster counts once, however many clones repeat it. Faking dispersion means doing real work for real outsiders over time. Like a zephyr crossing a grove, a genuine ripple touches many separate trees; a gust circling one thicket moves nothing.
